summary: 引擎无关的输入架构：命名动作、摇杆死区、按键缓冲和带冲突检查的改键，附 Godot InputMap 代码。 Engine-neutral input architecture with Godot InputMap code: named actions, stick deadzones, buffered presses and rebinding with conflict checks.
